rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something usually happens or is generally the rule.

example.english: We ordinarily finish work at seven.
example.traditional: 通常我哋七點鐘就收工。
example.jyutping: tung1 soeng4 ngo5 dei6 cat1 dim2 zung1 zau6 sau1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when “ordinarily” contrasts with what happens on an unusual or special occasion.

example.english: I ordinarily take the bus to work, but today I took a taxi.
example.traditional: 平時我搭巴士返工，今日就搭的士。
example.jyutping: ping4 si4 ngo5 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1 gam1 jat6 zau6 daap3 dik1 si2

rows.jyutping: ziu3 ping4 si4 gam2 joeng2 V
rows.note: Use this construction when an action is done in the usual manner, as in dressing or behaving as usual.

example.english: Even for banquets, I ordinarily dress as usual and do not make a special effort.
example.traditional: 去飲宴我都照平時咁樣着衫，唔使特登打扮。
example.jyutping: heoi3 jam2 jin3 ngo5 dou1 ziu3 ping4 si4 gam2 joeng2 zoek3 saam1 m4 sai2 dak6 dang1 daa2 baan6
